Delhi Police File FIRs Over INDIA Bloc March to Supreme Court

Delhi Police have registered four First Information Reports (FIRs) in connection with the INDIA bloc's protest march to the Supreme Court on October 12. The march was held to protest alleged irregularities in the NEET-UG 2024 examination results. The Supreme Court registry had also flagged defects in a petition submitted by the INDIA bloc.
